# CredSettle

> CredSettle helps borrowers in India whose unsecured debt (credit cards, personal loans and loan apps) totals ₹3,00,000 or more negotiate one-time settlements with their lenders, deal with recovery calls under RBI rules, and plan the credit-report impact of a "Settled" status. Office: 4th Floor, 2493AP, Block G, Sushant Lok 2, Sector 57, Gurugram, Haryana 122001. Phone: +91-8800226635.

Settlement is a last resort: a settled account is reported as "Settled" to credit bureaus and lowers the borrower's credit score. Pages below explain issuer and lender rules; figures on individual pages are dated where they come from RBI circulars or bank notices.

## Credit card settlement by issuer
- [Credit card settlement by bank: issuer directory](https://www.credsettle.com/credit-card-settlement-by-bank): every card issuer CredSettle covers, grouped by private, PSU, foreign and small finance banks, with the steps common to all.
- [Credit card settlement overview](https://www.credsettle.com/credit-card-settlement)
- [Settling several credit cards at once](https://www.credsettle.com/settle-multiple-credit-cards)
